messages:
Eli: Quick report - after updating sampleapp with latest node telemetry hooks we see blank request IDs at DEBUG/VERBOSE levels when OTEL is enabled. Repro on mac. :confused:
Rina: I can repro on ubuntu VM. Non-OTEL runs include x-request-id fine.
Tomas: Likely ordering/race: otelHook async-inits and log middleware expects req.ctx.reqId sync.
Eli: Minimal repro:
```js
app.use(telemetry.otelHook())
app.use(telemetry.logHook())
```
Eli: With retries the logger sometimes fires before the otel promise resolves; header present in req.headers but ctx empty.
Rina: Also saw REDACT_SENSITIVE=true removing the header key entirely during replay (not just masked).
Tomas: Two straightforward mitigations: 1) ensure otel init completes (await telemetry.init()) before mounting logHook, or 2) make logHook fall back to req.headers['x-request-id'] when ctx missing.
Eli: I filed a tiny issue and attached a failing unit. TW-6120.
telemetry-bot: Issue created: TW-6120 - "node: reqid missing at verbose when OTEL+retries" linked to PR draft.
ops-bot: Heads-up: hold sampleapp deploy until TW-6120 low-risk fix merged.
Rina: Will open a PR with non-destructive redaction + header fallback; prefer fallback first to avoid blocking on sync init for Private deployments.
Tomas: Agreed, add feature flag for sync-init if we want better UX later.
Eli: Thanks team - I'll add logs and exact repro commands to the ticket. :coffee:
